children.label: e
children.prompt:
Sketch the graph of $y=f(x)$, by factorising it first.
Show all important features.

answer.short: $f(x)=x^2(x-3)$. The curve touches the $x$-axis at the local maximum $(0,0)$, has a local minimum at $(2,-4)$ and crosses the $x$-axis at $(3,0)$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}f(x)&=x^3-3x^2\\&=x^2(x-3)\end{aligned}$$

The double zero at $x=0$ gives a touch at $(0,0)$; the simple zero at $x=3$ gives a crossing at $(3,0)$. Plot the local maximum $(0,0)$ and local minimum $(2,-4)$. The leading term is $x^3$, so $f(x)\to-\infty$ as $x\to-\infty$ and $f(x)\to\infty$ as $x\to\infty$.
